text: Generally, no. Checking your rate through prequalification typically uses a soft credit inquiry, which doesn't affect your credit score. A hard inquiry usually happens only when you formally apply and accept an offer, and it can cause a small, temporary dip in your score. I can't confirm which type of inquiry applies to your specific situation, so check the disclosure on the screen before you submit anything, as it should say whether a hard or soft pull will be used.
